cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 2.6)

set(KEYWORD "snippets")

# Start a project.
project(${KEYWORD})

# Find YARP.  Point the YARP_DIR environment variable at your build.
find_package(YARP REQUIRED)
find_package(MANIPULATION REQUIRED)

# Inclue any directories needed for YARP
include_directories(${YARP_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${MANIPULATION_INCLUDE_DIRS})

link_directories(${MANIPULATION_LINK_DIRS})

# Set up our executables.
add_executable(testTorque testTorque.cpp)
target_link_libraries(testTorque ${YARP_LIBRARIES} ManipulationYarp ${MANIPULATION_LIBRARIES})
